name: Conveying & Material-Handling Systems

activities: shop-fab of conveyor sections, gallery steel, drives
foundations for drive & tail ends, transfer towers, gallery supports
sequence.note: Civil enters only as the setting-out & foundation enabler.

activities: erect & align conveyor gallery / trestle / transfer-tower steel
sequence.note: Structural_steel interface — conveyor mounts on this.

activities: install drive & tail pulleys, take-up, gearbox / drive unit
belt splicing / vulcanising or chain assembly
field-device termination (speed, zero-speed, belt-drift, pull-cord, chute-plugged / level)
PLC / DCS interlock I/O loop check
integrated run with upstream feed & downstream receiving

typical_relationships.reason: The conveyor mounts on and is aligned to its support structure.

typical_relationships.before: drive & tail pulleys set and aligned
typical_relationships.reason: The belt is fitted around aligned pulleys and a set take-up.
The machine cannot run empty until the belt or chain is on and tensioned.

typical_relationships.after: motor / drive electrical connection & instrument termination
typical_relationships.reason: E&I connection follows mechanical completion of the drive train.
Safety interlocks must be live before the machine is first rotated.
Load runs only after empty runs prove tracking, direction and safety.

typical_relationships.before: upstream feeder & downstream receiving equipment ready
typical_relationships.reason: A conveyor is commissioned as part of the material-handling train, not in isolation.
Loaded operation without chutes/skirting causes uncontrolled spillage.

interfaces.requirement: Gallery / trestle / transfer-tower steel erected & aligned before conveyor mechanical install.
Drive/tail foundations, transfer-tower footings, pits & trenches ready before setting equipment.
Permanent power to the drive MCC before no-load commissioning.
Field devices (zero-speed, belt-drift, pull-cord, level) terminated & loop-checked before commissioning.
PLC/DCS interlock logic downloaded & I/O proven before first rotation.
Upstream feeders and downstream equipment ready for integrated loaded run.

testing_requirements: Shaft / pulley alignment, belt tracking and take-up travel check
Belt splice / vulcanising integrity (or chain tension) test
Gearbox oil fill & manual rotation check
Instrument loop checks — zero-speed, belt-drift, pull-cord, level, motor feedback
No-load run — direction, current draw, temperature, vibration, guard & E-stop function
Loaded run — throughput/capacity vs design, transfer spillage, sustained current & temperature
Cascade interlock proving with upstream / downstream equipment
commissioning_dependencies: Permanent power to drive and local control station live
All safety devices (pull-cords, guards, zero-speed) proven before first rotation
PLC/DCS interlock logic loaded and I/O loop-checked
Upstream feeders & downstream conveyors available for integrated (train) commissioning
Material available for loaded / throughput test
typical_exceptions: Packaged / skid-mounted short conveyors arrive largely pre-assembled, compressing erection
Pneumatic conveying is blower- & piping-driven, not belt/chain — a different sub-pattern
evidence: A conveyor is scheduled for loaded/throughput commissioning before its support steel, drive power, safety interlocks or no-load dry run are complete.
